shellCommands.command: git status --short; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.json' \) -print | grep -v node_modules | head -50; cat package.json; cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null

for f in lib/data.ts app/product/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/; grep -ril "unstable_instant\|prefetch" node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -30
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides; cat adopting-partial-prefetching.md; grep -n -i -B2 -A20 "prefetch=\|unstable_prefetch\|include" optimizing-prefetching.md | head -200
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides; grep -n -A80 "## Exclude content from a prefetch" optimizing-prefetching.md

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; cat 04-functions/prefetch.md; ls 04-functions | grep -i navig; grep -rn "partialPrefetching" 05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md | head; sed -n 1,80p 05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md
